summary: This configuration file sets up the development environment by loading variables from a .env file, adding a scripts directory to the system PATH so commands there can be run easily, and defining a project name variable that will be available to all processes.

explanations.2: This loads environment variables from a .env file into the current shell session, so sensitive config like database passwords don't need to be hardcoded.
explanations.5: This adds the ./scripts folder to PATH, which means any executable files in that folder can be run from anywhere without typing the full path.
explanations.8: The export keyword makes this variable available not just in this shell, but also to any child processes spawned from it, so your app can read APP_NAME as an environment variable.
